description.text: Program Introduction The MBBS program is run on a six-year duration. This comes with the first 5 years that entails a total of 10 semesters with the last twelve months being the internship year that is compulsory for all students. There is an early introduction to pre-clinical topics which provides the basis for medical studies in the subsequent years. In the two years students have to grasp the necessary knowledge that is applied during clinical training. Success in medicine requires application and hard work, both while studying and when in practice. However it brings great rewards in terms of job satisfaction, involving a combination of science and human interactions. Main Courses 1. Public courses: Chinese (intensive reading, listening and oral Chinese), brief introduction of China, healthy education. 2. Basic specialized courses: System Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry,Cell Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Pathology, Path physiology, Medical Genetics, Nutrition, Pharmacology, Social Medicine, Preventive Medicine, Local Anatomy, Health Statistics, Parasitological,Traditional Chinese Medicine. 3. Specialized courses: Diagnostics, Medical Imaging, Forensic Medicine, Clinical Immunology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Emergency Medicine, Clinical Anesthesiology, Epidemiology, Ophthalmology, Oral Sciences, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, Neurology, Infectious Diseases, Skin Epidemiology, Otolaryngology, Obstetrics and Gynecology. 4. Practice: fundamental medicine basic skills experiments, clinical fundamental skills practice, clinical practice. Please click here to view the curriculum of the MBBS program. Or click here to download the curriculum of the MBBS program. Internship The total duration of internship is 48 weeks basis. During intership, the concerned departments will lay emphasis on the practical experience of the student.

duration.text: The MBBS at Hebei North University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
